title: AykenOS Verification Evidence Schema
description: Schema for verification evidence produced by gates. CRITICAL VALIDATOR REQUIREMENTS: (1) canonical_evidence_hash = sha256(JSON without integrity.file_hash field) - file cannot contain its own hash, compute excluding that field, (2) sha256(details.command) MUST equal integrity.command_fingerprint, (3) adapter_output_fields MUST be subset of raw_source_fields, (4) IF raw_exit_code != 0 AND verdict == PASS THEN FAIL, (5) raw_verdict MUST equal verdict (adapter cannot change verdict), (6) evidence.determinism_level MUST equal manifest.determinism_level (no mismatch), (7) IF manifest.build_fingerprint_required THEN evidence.build_fingerprint MUST exist, (8) IF manifest.required_verdict == FAIL THEN gate passes when evidence.verdict == FAIL

gate_id.description: Gate identifier that produced this evidence

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (must match current verification run)

marker_sequence.description: Markers found in execution order (required for marker-level determinism)

trace_hash.description: SHA256 hash of execution trace (required for trace-level determinism)

artifact_hash.description: SHA256 hash of produced artifact (required for artifact-level determinism)

build_fingerprint.description: SHA256 hash of kernel + toolchain + build_flags (optional, prevents binary drift)

raw_exit_code.description: Actual gate command exit code (REQUIRED for truth enforcement)

raw_log_hash.description: SHA256 hash of raw gate output

raw_verdict.description: Verdict from raw gate output before adapter (REQUIRED for truth enforcement)

raw_source_fields.description: Fields present in raw gate output (for adapter validation)

adapter_output_fields.description: Fields in adapter output (must be subset of raw_source_fields)

file_hash.description: SHA256 hash of this evidence file (computed excluding this field itself - canonical hash without integrity.file_hash)

source_gate_id.description: Gate ID that produced this evidence

command_fingerprint.description: SHA256 hash of command string (REQUIRED for command verification)
